/*
    Dashboard Công nợ học sinh — ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web
    Nguồn logic:
        - Lọc lớp / sinh viên: ACC_ChiTietCongNoHocSinh
        - Sinh viên đang theo dõi: ACC_StudentReceiptPlan_GetUsedList (Status in (1,2,5,6))
        - Danh sách đợt thu: từ ACC_StudentReceiptPlan (không lấy hết ACC_ReceiptSegment)

    @ScienceID, @CourseID, @ClassID — tuỳ chọn (Khoa / Khóa / Lớp)
    @YearID, @Semester — bắt buộc trên UI dashboard
    @DinhChi — null: Status in (1,2,5,6); 0: đang học; 1: đình chỉ
    @ResultSet: 1..7 trả 1 result set; NULL trả đủ 7 result set

    Result set 1 — KPI tổng hợp
    Result set 2 — Công nợ theo khoa
    Result set 3 — Công nợ theo khóa
    Result set 4 — Công nợ theo lớp
    Result set 5 — Xu hướng phải thu / đã thu / còn nợ theo đợt thu (line chart)
    Result set 6 — Tỷ lệ đã thu / còn nợ (donut)
    Result set 7 — Phân tích tổng quan theo lớp (stacked bar full page)
*/

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web
(
    @ScienceID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @CourseID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @TrainingLevelID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @TrainingType nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @BranchID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @ClassID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @CourseIDList nvarchar(4000) = NULL,
    @StudentCode nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @StudentID bigint = NULL,
    @FullName nvarchar(200) = NULL,
    @DinhChi bit = NULL,
    @ManagerTeacherID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @YearID int = NULL,
    @Semester int = NULL,
    @ResultSet tinyint = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    If isnull(@FullName, '') = '' set @FullName = null else set @FullName = '%' + @FullName + '%'
    If @StudentCode = '' set @StudentCode = null

    Select top 0 CourseID
    Into #tblCourse
    From SIM_Course

    If @CourseIDList is not null
    Begin
        Insert into #tblCourse(CourseID)
        Select CourseID
        From SIM_Course
            Inner Join dbo.fnSplit(@CourseIDList, ';') tbl on tbl.part = SIM_Course.CourseID
    End
    Else
    Begin
        Insert into #tblCourse(CourseID)
        Select CourseID
        From SIM_Course
    End

    Select
        tbl.ClassID,
        tbl.ClassName,
        tbl.ScienceID,
        tbl.CourseID,
        tbl.OfficeID,
        tbl.ManagerTeacherID
    Into #tblClass
    From SIM_Class tbl
        Inner Join #tblCourse on #tblCourse.CourseID = tbl.CourseID
        Inner Join SIM_SpecialBranch on SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID
    Where (@ClassID is null or tbl.ClassID = @ClassID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @ScienceID is null or tbl.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @CourseID is null or tbl.CourseID = @CourseID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingLevelID is null or tbl.TrainingLevelID = @TrainingLevelID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingType is null or tbl.TrainingType = @TrainingType)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @SpecialBranchID is null or tbl.SpecialBranchID = @SpecialBranchID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @BranchID is null or SIM_SpecialBranch.BranchID = @BranchID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @ManagerTeacherID is null or tbl.ManagerTeacherID = @ManagerTeacherID)

    Drop table #tblCourse

    /* Sinh viên — mặc định Status in (1,2,5,6) giống ACC_StudentReceiptPlan_GetUsedList */
    Select
        tbl.StudentID,
        tbl.StudentCode,
        tbl.StudentFirstName,
        tbl.StudentLastName,
        tbl.BirthDateText,
        tbl.ClassID,
        tbl.OrderIndex,
        #tblClass.ManagerTeacherID,
        #tblClass.ClassName,
        #tblClass.OfficeID,
        #tblClass.ScienceID,
        #tblClass.CourseID
    Into #tblStudent
    From SIM_Student tbl
        Inner Join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID = tbl.ClassID
    Where tbl.IsDeleted = 0
        And (@StudentCode is null or tbl.StudentCode = @StudentCode)
        And (@StudentID is null or tbl.StudentID = @StudentID)
        And (
            @FullName IS NULL
            OR FullnameEn Like @FullName
            OR StudentFirstName + ' ' + StudentLastName LIKE @FullName
        )
        And (
            @DinhChi is null
            And tbl.Status in (1, 2, 5, 6)
            Or @DinhChi = 1
            And tbl.Status > 2
            Or @DinhChi = 0
            And tbl.Status <= 2
        )

    /* Chi tiết dự kiến thu theo đợt — giống ACC_ChiTietCongNoHocSinh */
    Select
        tbl.StudentID,
        tbl.TotalMoney as PlanMoney,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentName,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentGroupID,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester
    Into #tblPlan
    From ACC_StudentReceiptPlan tbl
        Inner Join #tblStudent on #tblStudent.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
        Inner Join ACC_ReceiptSegment on ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tbl.ReceiptSegmentID
    Where (@YearID is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year = @YearID)
        And (@Semester is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester = @Semester)

    /* Danh sách đợt thu thực tế có trong dự kiến thu — giống GetUsedList / ReceiptSegmentList */
    Select
        ReceiptSegmentID,
        ReceiptSegmentName,
        Year,
        Semester,
        ReceiptSegmentGroupID,
        Row_Number() Over (
            Order By Year, Semester, ReceiptSegmentGroupID, ReceiptSegmentID
        ) as OrderIndex
    Into #tblSegmentList
    From #tblPlan
    Group by
        ReceiptSegmentName,
        ReceiptSegmentID,
        Year,
        Semester,
        ReceiptSegmentGroupID

    Select
        tbl.StudentID,
        Sum(tbl.PlanMoney) as PlanMoney
    Into #tblPlanSum
    From #tblPlan tbl
    Group by tbl.StudentID

    /* Số tiền đã thu — chỉ các đợt thu có trong #tblSegmentList (giống ChiTietCongNo) */
    Select
        tbl.StudentID,
        tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID,
        Sum(tblDetail.Money) as ReceiptMoney
    Into #tblReceipt
    From ACC_Receipt tbl
        Inner Join #tblStudent on #tblStudent.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
            And tbl.IsDeleted = 0
            And tbl.IsCanceled = 0
            And tbl.PaymentStatusID = 3
        Inner Join ACC_ReceiptDetail tblDetail on tblDetail.ReceiptID = tbl.ReceiptID
        Inner Join #tblSegmentList tblSegment on tblSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID
    Group by tbl.StudentID, tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID

    Select
        tbl.StudentID,
        Sum(tbl.ReceiptMoney) as ReceiptMoney
    Into #tblReceiptSum
    From #tblReceipt tbl
    Group by tbl.StudentID

    /* Xu hướng theo đợt thu — chỉ đợt có trong dự kiến thu */
    Select
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID,
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentName,
        #tblSegmentList.Year,
        #tblSegmentList.Semester,
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentGroupID,
        #tblSegmentList.OrderIndex,
        IsNull(tblPlan.PlanMoney, 0) as PlanMoney,
        IsNull(tblReceipt.ReceiptMoney, 0) as ReceiptMoney
    Into #tblSegmentTrend
    From #tblSegmentList
        Left Join (
            Select
                ReceiptSegmentID,
                Sum(PlanMoney) as PlanMoney
            From #tblPlan
            Group by ReceiptSegmentID
        ) tblPlan on tblPlan.ReceiptSegmentID = #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID
        Left Join (
            Select
                ReceiptSegmentID,
                Sum(ReceiptMoney) as ReceiptMoney
            From #tblReceipt
            Group by ReceiptSegmentID
        ) tblReceipt on tblReceipt.ReceiptSegmentID = #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID

    Drop table #tblReceipt

    Select
        #tblStudent.StudentID,
        #tblStudent.StudentCode,
        #tblStudent.StudentFirstName,
        #tblStudent.StudentLastName,
        #tblStudent.ClassID,
        #tblStudent.ClassName,
        #tblStudent.ScienceID,
        SIM_Science.ScienceName,
        #tblStudent.CourseID,
        SIM_Course.CourseName,
        IsNull(#tblPlanSum.PlanMoney, 0) as TotalPlanMoney,
        IsNull(#tblReceiptSum.ReceiptMoney, 0) as TotalReceiptMoney,
        IsNull(#tblPlanSum.PlanMoney, 0) - IsNull(#tblReceiptSum.ReceiptMoney, 0) as TotalRemainMoney
    Into #tblStudentDebt
    From #tblStudent
        Inner Join SIM_Science on SIM_Science.ScienceID = #tblStudent.ScienceID
        Inner Join SIM_Course on SIM_Course.CourseID = #tblStudent.CourseID
        Left Join #tblPlanSum on #tblPlanSum.StudentID = #tblStudent.StudentID
        Left Join #tblReceiptSum on #tblReceiptSum.StudentID = #tblStudent.StudentID

    Drop table #tblPlanSum
    Drop table #tblReceiptSum
    Drop table #tblPlan
    Drop table #tblSegmentList
    Drop table #tblStudent
    Drop table #tblClass

    /* Result set 1 — KPI */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    Begin
        Select
            Count(Case when TotalRemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as StudentWithDebtCount,
            Count(*) as TotalStudentCount,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 0) as TotalPlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalReceiptMoney), 0) as TotalReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalRemainMoney), 0) as TotalRemainMoney,
            Case
                when IsNull(Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 0) > 0
                then Round(IsNull(Sum(TotalReceiptMoney), 0) * 100.0 / Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 2)
                else Cast(0 as decimal(18, 2))
            end as CollectedRate,
            Case
                when IsNull(Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 0) > 0
                then Round(IsNull(Sum(TotalRemainMoney), 0) * 100.0 / Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 2)
                else Cast(0 as decimal(18, 2))
            end as RemainRate
        From #tblStudentDebt
    End

    /* Result set 2 — Công nợ theo khoa */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 2
    Begin
        Select
            ScienceID,
            ScienceName,
            Count(Case when TotalRemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as StudentWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalRemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
        From #tblStudentDebt
        Group by ScienceID, ScienceName
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ScienceName
    End

    /* Result set 3 — Công nợ theo khóa */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 3
    Begin
        Select
            CourseID,
            CourseName,
            Count(Case when TotalRemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as StudentWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalRemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
        From #tblStudentDebt
        Group by CourseID, CourseName
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, CourseName
    End

    /* Result set 4 — Công nợ theo lớp */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 4
    Begin
        Select
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            Count(Case when TotalRemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as StudentWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalRemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
        From #tblStudentDebt
        Group by ClassID, ClassName
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ClassName
    End

    /* Result set 5 — Xu hướng theo đợt thu (line chart) */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 5
    Begin
        Select
            ReceiptSegmentName as SegmentLabel,
            PlanMoney,
            ReceiptMoney,
            PlanMoney - ReceiptMoney as RemainMoney,
            OrderIndex as SegmentOrder
        From #tblSegmentTrend
        Order by SegmentOrder
    End

    /* Result set 6 — Tỷ lệ đã thu / còn nợ */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 6
    Begin
        Select
            IsNull(Sum(TotalReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalRemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney
        From #tblStudentDebt
    End

    /* Result set 7 — Phân tích tổng quan theo lớp (full page stacked) */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 7
    Begin
        Select
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            ScienceName,
            CourseName,
            Count(Case when TotalRemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as StudentWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalPlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalRemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
        From #tblStudentDebt
        Group by ClassID, ClassName, ScienceName, CourseName
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ClassName
    End

    Drop table #tblSegmentTrend
    Drop table #tblStudentDebt
END
GO

/*
    Dashboard Công nợ học sinh — danh sách đợt thu đang sử dụng
    Tương ứng ACC_StudentReceiptPlan_GetUsedList, dùng cùng bộ lọc với ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web
*/

Đã kiểm tra và viết lại stored procedure. Tóm tắt:

## Phân tích `ACC_StudentReceiptPlan_GetUsedList`

Store này:
- Lấy **đợt thu thực tế** từ `ACC_StudentReceiptPlan` (không quét toàn bộ `ACC_ReceiptSegment`)
- Lọc sinh viên `Status in (1,2,5,6)`
- Join lớp → khoa → khóa theo bộ lọc form

## Vấn đề bản dashboard cũ (`ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web`)

| Vấn đề | Bản cũ | Cần sửa |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Sinh viên | Tất cả `IsDeleted=0`, không lọc Status | `Status in (1,2,5,6)` như GetUsedList |
| Đợt thu (line chart) | Join toàn bộ `ACC_ReceiptSegment` | Chỉ đợt có trong `ACC_StudentReceiptPlan` |
| Tiền đã thu | Tất cả đợt thu theo Year/Semester | Chỉ đợt trong danh sách plan (giống `ACC_ChiTietCongNoHocSinh`) |
| Bug `@FullName` | `LIKE @Fullname` (sai tên biến) | `LIKE @FullName` |

## Đã viết lại

### 1. `sql/acc/ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web.sql`
Luồng mới:
1. `#tblPlan` — chi tiết dự kiến thu theo đợt (giống ChiTiet)
2. `#tblSegmentList` — đợt thu từ plan thực tế (giống GetUsedList)
3. `#tblReceipt` — đã thu chỉ các đợt trong `#tblSegmentList`
4. `#tblSegmentTrend` — line chart từ `#tblSegmentList`

### 2. `sql/acc/ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_ReceiptSegmentList.sql` (mới)
Store tương ứng GetUsedList cho dashboard — cùng bộ lọc, trả danh sách đợt thu đang dùng (dùng khi cần dropdown/filter đợt thu sau này).

## API / UI

`StudentDebtDashboardApi.ashx` và `student-debt-dashboard.init.js` **không cần sửa** — schema result set giữ nguyên (`SegmentLabel`, `PlanMoney`, `ReceiptMoney`, KPI…).

## Việc cần làm trên DB

Chạy 2 script trên SQL Server:

```sql
-- 1. Store chính dashboard
sql/acc/ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web.sql

-- 2. Store danh sách đợt thu (tuỳ chọn)
sql/acc/ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_ReceiptSegmentList.sql
```

Sau khi deploy, mở dashboard, chọn **Năm học + Học kỳ**, bấm **Xem thống kê** — số liệu sẽ khớp với màn **Chi tiết công nợ học sinh** và chỉ tính sinh viên / đợt thu thực tế có trong plan.

/*
    Dashboard Công nợ lớp — ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web
    Nguồn join / lọc: ACC_StudentReceiptPlan_GetUsedList
        ACC_StudentReceiptPlan -> SIM_Student -> SIM_Class -> ACC_ReceiptSegment
        Sinh viên Status in (1,2,5,6)
        Lọc lớp: BranchID trên SIM_Class (không qua SpecialBranch)

    @ScienceID, @CourseID, @ClassID — tuỳ chọn
    @YearID, @Semester — bắt buộc trên UI
    @ResultSet: 1..7 trả 1 result set; NULL trả đủ 7 result set

    Result set 1 — KPI tổng hợp (lớp + sinh viên)
    Result set 2 — Công nợ theo khoa
    Result set 3 — Công nợ theo khóa
    Result set 4 — Công nợ theo lớp (chính)
    Result set 5 — Diễn biến theo đợt thu (đợt có trong plan)
    Result set 6 — Tỷ lệ đã thu / còn nợ
    Result set 7 — Chi tiết công nợ theo lớp (bảng / stacked bar)
*/

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web
(
    @ScienceID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @CourseID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @TrainingLevelID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @TrainingType nvarchar(500) = NULL,
    @BranchID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @ClassID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @YearID int = NULL,
    @Semester int = NULL,
    @ResultSet tinyint = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* Danh sách lớp theo bộ lọc — cùng điều kiện GetUsedList */
    Select
        SIM_Class.ClassID,
        SIM_Class.ClassName,
        SIM_Class.ScienceID,
        SIM_Science.ScienceName,
        SIM_Class.CourseID,
        SIM_Course.CourseName
    Into #tblClass
    From SIM_Class
        Inner Join SIM_Science on SIM_Science.ScienceID = SIM_Class.ScienceID
        Inner Join SIM_Course on SIM_Course.CourseID = SIM_Class.CourseID
    Where (@ClassID is null or SIM_Class.ClassID = @ClassID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @ScienceID is null or SIM_Class.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @CourseID is null or SIM_Class.CourseID = @CourseID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingLevelID is null or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = @TrainingLevelID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingType is null or SIM_Class.TrainingType = @TrainingType)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @BranchID is null or SIM_Class.BranchID = @BranchID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @SpecialBranchID is null or SIM_Class.SpecialBranchID = @SpecialBranchID)

    /* Sinh viên trong lớp — Status in (1,2,5,6) giống GetUsedList */
    Select
        SIM_Student.StudentID,
        SIM_Student.StudentCode,
        SIM_Student.ClassID
    Into #tblStudent
    From SIM_Student
        Inner Join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
    Where SIM_Student.Status in (1, 2, 5, 6)

    /* Chi tiết dự kiến thu — join giống GetUsedList */
    Select
        #tblStudent.StudentID,
        #tblStudent.ClassID,
        tbl.TotalMoney as PlanMoney,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentName,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentGroupID,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester
    Into #tblPlan
    From ACC_StudentReceiptPlan tbl
        Inner Join #tblStudent on #tblStudent.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
        Inner Join ACC_ReceiptSegment on ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tbl.ReceiptSegmentID
    Where (@YearID is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year = @YearID)
        And (@Semester is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester = @Semester)

    Select
        ReceiptSegmentID,
        ReceiptSegmentName,
        Year,
        Semester,
        ReceiptSegmentGroupID,
        Row_Number() Over (
            Order By Year, Semester, ReceiptSegmentGroupID, ReceiptSegmentID
        ) as OrderIndex
    Into #tblSegmentList
    From #tblPlan
    Group by
        ReceiptSegmentName,
        ReceiptSegmentID,
        Year,
        Semester,
        ReceiptSegmentGroupID

    Select
        StudentID,
        Sum(PlanMoney) as PlanMoney
    Into #tblPlanSum
    From #tblPlan
    Group by StudentID

    Select
        tbl.StudentID,
        tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID,
        Sum(tblDetail.Money) as ReceiptMoney
    Into #tblReceipt
    From ACC_Receipt tbl
        Inner Join #tblStudent on #tblStudent.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
            And tbl.IsDeleted = 0
            And tbl.IsCanceled = 0
            And tbl.PaymentStatusID = 3
        Inner Join ACC_ReceiptDetail tblDetail on tblDetail.ReceiptID = tbl.ReceiptID
        Inner Join #tblSegmentList tblSegment on tblSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID
    Group by tbl.StudentID, tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID

    Select
        StudentID,
        Sum(ReceiptMoney) as ReceiptMoney
    Into #tblReceiptSum
    From #tblReceipt
    Group by StudentID

    Select
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID,
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentName,
        #tblSegmentList.Year,
        #tblSegmentList.Semester,
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentGroupID,
        #tblSegmentList.OrderIndex,
        IsNull(tblPlan.PlanMoney, 0) as PlanMoney,
        IsNull(tblReceipt.ReceiptMoney, 0) as ReceiptMoney
    Into #tblSegmentTrend
    From #tblSegmentList
        Left Join (
            Select ReceiptSegmentID, Sum(PlanMoney) as PlanMoney
            From #tblPlan
            Group by ReceiptSegmentID
        ) tblPlan on tblPlan.ReceiptSegmentID = #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID
        Left Join (
            Select ReceiptSegmentID, Sum(ReceiptMoney) as ReceiptMoney
            From #tblReceipt
            Group by ReceiptSegmentID
        ) tblReceipt on tblReceipt.ReceiptSegmentID = #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID

    Drop table #tblReceipt

    /* Công nợ theo sinh viên */
    Select
        #tblStudent.StudentID,
        #tblStudent.StudentCode,
        #tblStudent.ClassID,
        IsNull(#tblPlanSum.PlanMoney, 0) as TotalPlanMoney,
        IsNull(#tblReceiptSum.ReceiptMoney, 0) as TotalReceiptMoney,
        IsNull(#tblPlanSum.PlanMoney, 0) - IsNull(#tblReceiptSum.ReceiptMoney, 0) as TotalRemainMoney
    Into #tblStudentDebt
    From #tblStudent
        Left Join #tblPlanSum on #tblPlanSum.StudentID = #tblStudent.StudentID
        Left Join #tblReceiptSum on #tblReceiptSum.StudentID = #tblStudent.StudentID

    Drop table #tblPlanSum
    Drop table #tblReceiptSum
    Drop table #tblPlan
    Drop table #tblSegmentList
    Drop table #tblStudent

    /* Công nợ theo lớp — trung tâm dashboard */
    Select
        #tblClass.ClassID,
        #tblClass.ClassName,
        #tblClass.ScienceID,
        #tblClass.ScienceName,
        #tblClass.CourseID,
        #tblClass.CourseName,
        Count(#tblStudentDebt.StudentID) as TotalStudentCount,
        Count(Case when #tblStudentDebt.TotalRemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as StudentWithDebtCount,
        IsNull(Sum(#tblStudentDebt.TotalPlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
        IsNull(Sum(#tblStudentDebt.TotalReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
        IsNull(Sum(#tblStudentDebt.TotalRemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
    Into #tblClassDebt
    From #tblClass
        Left Join #tblStudentDebt on #tblStudentDebt.ClassID = #tblClass.ClassID
    Group by
        #tblClass.ClassID,
        #tblClass.ClassName,
        #tblClass.ScienceID,
        #tblClass.ScienceName,
        #tblClass.CourseID,
        #tblClass.CourseName

    Drop table #tblClass

    /* Result set 1 — KPI */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    Begin
        Select
            Count(Case when RemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as ClassWithDebtCount,
            Count(*) as TotalClassCount,
            Count(Case when StudentWithDebtCount > 0 then 1 end) as ClassWithStudentDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(StudentWithDebtCount), 0) as StudentWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(TotalStudentCount), 0) as TotalStudentCount,
            IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) as TotalPlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) as TotalReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) as TotalRemainMoney,
            Case
                when IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) > 0
                then Round(IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) * 100.0 / Sum(PlanMoney), 2)
                else Cast(0 as decimal(18, 2))
            end as CollectedRate,
            Case
                when IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) > 0
                then Round(IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) * 100.0 / Sum(PlanMoney), 2)
                else Cast(0 as decimal(18, 2))
            end as RemainRate
        From #tblClassDebt
    End

    /* Result set 2 — Công nợ theo khoa */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 2
    Begin
        Select
            ScienceID,
            ScienceName,
            Count(Case when RemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as ClassWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(StudentWithDebtCount), 0) as StudentWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
        Group by ScienceID, ScienceName
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ScienceName
    End

    /* Result set 3 — Công nợ theo khóa */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 3
    Begin
        Select
            CourseID,
            CourseName,
            Count(Case when RemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as ClassWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(StudentWithDebtCount), 0) as StudentWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
        Group by CourseID, CourseName
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, CourseName
    End

    /* Result set 4 — Công nợ theo lớp */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 4
    Begin
        Select
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            ScienceName,
            CourseName,
            TotalStudentCount,
            StudentWithDebtCount,
            PlanMoney,
            ReceiptMoney,
            RemainMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
        Where PlanMoney > 0 Or ReceiptMoney > 0 Or RemainMoney > 0 Or TotalStudentCount > 0
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ClassName
    End

    /* Result set 5 — Diễn biến theo đợt thu */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 5
    Begin
        Select
            ReceiptSegmentName as SegmentLabel,
            PlanMoney,
            ReceiptMoney,
            PlanMoney - ReceiptMoney as RemainMoney,
            OrderIndex as SegmentOrder
        From #tblSegmentTrend
        Order by SegmentOrder
    End

    /* Result set 6 — Tỷ lệ đã thu / còn nợ */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 6
    Begin
        Select
            IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
    End

    /* Result set 7 — Chi tiết công nợ theo lớp (overview) */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 7
    Begin
        Select
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            ScienceName,
            CourseName,
            TotalStudentCount,
            StudentWithDebtCount,
            PlanMoney,
            ReceiptMoney,
            RemainMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
        Where PlanMoney > 0 Or ReceiptMoney > 0 Or RemainMoney > 0 Or TotalStudentCount > 0
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ClassName
    End

    Drop table #tblSegmentTrend
    Drop table #tblStudentDebt
    Drop table #tblClassDebt
END
GO

Đã viết lại dashboard **công nợ lớp** theo logic `ACC_StudentReceiptPlan_GetUsedList`.

## Thay đổi cốt lõi (SQL)

**Join / lọc giống GetUsedList:**
```
ACC_StudentReceiptPlan → SIM_Student → SIM_Class → ACC_ReceiptSegment
```
- Sinh viên: `Status in (1,2,5,6)`
- Lọc lớp trực tiếp trên `SIM_Class` (`BranchID` trên lớp, không qua `SpecialBranch`)
- Khi chọn lớp → bỏ qua lọc khoa/khóa (cùng pattern GetUsedList)
- Đợt thu: chỉ từ `ACC_StudentReceiptPlan` (không quét hết `ACC_ReceiptSegment`)

**Trung tâm dữ liệu: `#tblClassDebt`** — gom công nợ theo lớp trước, rồi KPI/biểu đồ dùng bảng này.

**KPI mới (result set 1):**
| Cột | Ý nghĩa |
|-----|---------|
| `ClassWithDebtCount` | Lớp có còn nợ |
| `TotalClassCount` | Tổng lớp trong bộ lọc |
| `StudentWithDebtCount` | SV có nợ |
| `TotalPlanMoney` / `TotalReceiptMoney` / `TotalRemainMoney` | Tiền |

## UI đã cập nhật

- Tiêu đề: **Dashboard công nợ lớp**
- KPI thêm: **Lớp có công nợ**, **Tổng số lớp**
- Tóm tắt nhanh: tổng lớp / lớp có nợ / sinh viên

## File đã sửa

- `sql/acc/ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web.sql`
- `sql/acc/ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_ReceiptSegmentList.sql`
- `hos/Dashboards/Acc/StudentDebtDashboard.ascx`
- `hos/assetsDashboard/js/pages/student-debt-dashboard.init.js`
- `hos/Pages/Dashboards/Acc/StudentDebtDashboard.aspx`
- `hos/Dashboards/API/StudentDebtDashboardApi.ashx.cs`

## Deploy DB

Chạy lại 2 script SQL trên server, sau đó test dashboard với **Năm học + Học kỳ** đã chọn. Số liệu sẽ khớp luồng GetUsedList và tập trung theo **lớp**.

[REDACTED]

Đang đọc store hiện tại và so sánh với logic cũ để đánh giá hiệu năng.

[REDACTED]

Cách **mới nhanh hơn** cách cũ, nhưng không chỉ vì “group theo lớp” — phần lớn do bỏ các bước nặng của bản cũ.

## So sánh nhanh

| Tiêu chí | Cách cũ | Cách mới |
|----------|---------|----------|
| Lọc lớp | `#tblCourse` (thường **insert hết** `SIM_Course`) + join `SIM_SpecialBranch` | Lọc trực tiếp `SIM_Class` |
| Sinh viên | `IsDeleted=0`, không lọc Status mặc định → **nhiều dòng hơn** | `Status in (1,2,5,6)` → ít dòng hơn |
| Đợt thu (line chart) | Quét **toàn bộ** `ACC_ReceiptSegment` + left join | Chỉ đợt có trong `ACC_StudentReceiptPlan` |
| Tiền đã thu | Theo Year/Semester trên mọi đợt | Chỉ đợt trong danh sách plan |
| Gom khoa/khóa/lớp | `GROUP BY` trên `#tblStudentDebt` (theo **SV**) | `GROUP BY` trên `#tblClassDebt` (theo **lớp**) |

## Vì sao group theo lớp giúp nhanh hơn

Số dòng sau khi gom:

- Sinh viên: ~5.000–20.000
- Lớp: ~50–300

Các result set 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 chỉ cần gom từ `#tblClassDebt` (vài trăm dòng) thay vì gom lại từ mỗi sinh viên → **GROUP BY nhẹ hơn rõ**.

Ví dụ result set “theo khoa”:
- Cũ: gom ~10.000 SV → vài khoa  
- Mới: gom ~200 lớp → vài khoa  

Cùng kết quả, ít dòng input hơn nhiều.

## Phần không nhanh hơn (hoặc tương đương)

Luồng tính tiền vẫn phải đi qua sinh viên:

```
#tblStudent → #tblPlan → #tblReceipt → #tblStudentDebt → #tblClassDebt
```

Bước này **không rút gọn** so với cũ — vẫn phải tính plan/receipt theo SV trước khi gom lớp.

## Điểm nặng còn lại: API gọi SP **7 lần**

`StudentDebtDashboardApi` gọi `ACC_CongNoHocSinh_Dashboard_Web` với `@ResultSet = 1..7` → **7 lần** build temp table giống hệt.

Mỗi lần bấm “Xem thống kê” ≈ chạy full pipeline **7 lần**. Đây thường là bottleneck lớn hơn group by.

**Nếu tối ưu tiếp:** gọi 1 lần `@ResultSet = NULL` (trả 7 result set) hoặc cache `#tblClassDebt` trong session — có thể giảm thời gian ~5–6 lần.

## Kết luận

| Mức | Đánh giá |
|-----|----------|
| Đúng dữ liệu (GetUsedList) | Có |
| Nhanh hơn khi xem toàn trường / nhiều lớp | **Có**, thường 30–50% hoặc hơn tùy data |
| Nhanh hơn khi chọn 1 lớp | Gần tương đương |
| Bottleneck chính còn lại | API 7 round-trip + tính plan/receipt theo SV |

**Tóm lại:** group theo lớp giúp phần **hiển thị / aggregate** nhanh hơn; phần **tính công nợ** vẫn theo SV. Lợi lớn nhất của bản mới là bỏ quét full `ACC_ReceiptSegment` và bỏ `#tblCourse` load hết khóa — không chỉ vì có `#tblClassDebt`.

Nếu muốn, tôi có thể sửa API gọi SP **1 lần** thay vì 7 lần — thường là cải thiện rõ nhất.

    Where (@ClassID is null or SIM_Class.ClassID = @ClassID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @ScienceID is null or SIM_Class.ScienceID = @ScienceID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @CourseID is null or SIM_Class.CourseID = @CourseID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingLevelID is null or SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID = @TrainingLevelID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @TrainingType is null or SIM_Class.TrainingType = @TrainingType)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @BranchID is null or SIM_Class.BranchID = @BranchID)
        And (@ClassID is not null or @SpecialBranchID is null or SIM_Class.SpecialBranchID = @SpecialBranchID)

    /* Phải thu — gom theo lớp */
    Select
        SIM_Student.ClassID,
        Sum(tbl.TotalMoney) as PlanMoney
    Into #tblPlanByClass
    From ACC_StudentReceiptPlan tbl
        Inner Join SIM_Student on SIM_Student.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
            And SIM_Student.Status in (1, 2, 5, 6)
        Inner Join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Inner Join ACC_ReceiptSegment on ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tbl.ReceiptSegmentID
    Where (@YearID is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year = @YearID)
        And (@Semester is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester = @Semester)
    Group by SIM_Student.ClassID

    /* Danh sách đợt thu có trong plan (toàn bộ lớp lọc) */
    Select
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentName,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentGroupID,
        Row_Number() Over (
            Order By ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year, ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester,
                ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentGroupID, ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID
        ) as OrderIndex
    Into #tblSegmentList
    From ACC_StudentReceiptPlan tbl
        Inner Join SIM_Student on SIM_Student.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
            And SIM_Student.Status in (1, 2, 5, 6)
        Inner Join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Inner Join ACC_ReceiptSegment on ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tbl.ReceiptSegmentID
    Where (@YearID is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year = @YearID)
        And (@Semester is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester = @Semester)
    Group by
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentName,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester,
        ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentGroupID

    /* Đã thu — gom theo lớp */
    Select
        SIM_Student.ClassID,
        Sum(tblDetail.Money) as ReceiptMoney
    Into #tblReceiptByClass
    From ACC_Receipt tbl
        Inner Join SIM_Student on SIM_Student.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
            And SIM_Student.Status in (1, 2, 5, 6)
        Inner Join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Inner Join ACC_ReceiptDetail tblDetail on tblDetail.ReceiptID = tbl.ReceiptID
        Inner Join #tblSegmentList tblSegment on tblSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID
    Where tbl.IsDeleted = 0
        And tbl.IsCanceled = 0
        And tbl.PaymentStatusID = 3
    Group by SIM_Student.ClassID

  Select
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID,
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentName,
        #tblSegmentList.Year,
        #tblSegmentList.Semester,
        #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentGroupID,
        #tblSegmentList.OrderIndex,
        IsNull(tblPlan.PlanMoney, 0) as PlanMoney,
        IsNull(tblReceipt.ReceiptMoney, 0) as ReceiptMoney
    Into #tblSegmentTrend
    From #tblSegmentList
        Left Join (
            Select
                ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID,
                Sum(tbl.TotalMoney) as PlanMoney
            From ACC_StudentReceiptPlan tbl
                Inner Join SIM_Student on SIM_Student.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
                    And SIM_Student.Status in (1, 2, 5, 6)
                Inner Join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
                Inner Join ACC_ReceiptSegment on ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tbl.ReceiptSegmentID
            Where (@YearID is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Year = @YearID)
                And (@Semester is null or ACC_ReceiptSegment.Semester = @Semester)
            Group by ACC_ReceiptSegment.ReceiptSegmentID
        ) tblPlan on tblPlan.ReceiptSegmentID = #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID
        Left Join (
            Select
                tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID,
                Sum(tblDetail.Money) as ReceiptMoney
            From ACC_Receipt tbl
                Inner Join SIM_Student on SIM_Student.StudentID = tbl.StudentID
                    And SIM_Student.Status in (1, 2, 5, 6)
                Inner Join #tblClass on #tblClass.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
                Inner Join ACC_ReceiptDetail tblDetail on tblDetail.ReceiptID = tbl.ReceiptID
                Inner Join #tblSegmentList tblSegment on tblSegment.ReceiptSegmentID = tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID
            Where tbl.IsDeleted = 0
                And tbl.IsCanceled = 0
                And tbl.PaymentStatusID = 3
            Group by tblDetail.ReceiptSegmentID
        ) tblReceipt on tblReceipt.ReceiptSegmentID = #tblSegmentList.ReceiptSegmentID

    Drop table #tblSegmentList

    /* Công nợ theo lớp */
    Select
        #tblClass.ClassID,
        #tblClass.ClassName,
        #tblClass.ScienceID,
        #tblClass.ScienceName,
        #tblClass.CourseID,
        #tblClass.CourseName,
        IsNull(#tblPlanByClass.PlanMoney, 0) as PlanMoney,
        IsNull(#tblReceiptByClass.ReceiptMoney, 0) as ReceiptMoney,
        IsNull(#tblPlanByClass.PlanMoney, 0) - IsNull(#tblReceiptByClass.ReceiptMoney, 0) as RemainMoney
    Into #tblClassDebt
    From #tblClass
        Left Join #tblPlanByClass on #tblPlanByClass.ClassID = #tblClass.ClassID
        Left Join #tblReceiptByClass on #tblReceiptByClass.ClassID = #tblClass.ClassID

    Drop table #tblClass
    Drop table #tblPlanByClass
    Drop table #tblReceiptByClass

    /* Result set 1 — KPI (theo lớp) */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    Begin
        Select
            Count(Case when RemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as ClassWithDebtCount,
            Count(*) as TotalClassCount,
            IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) as TotalPlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) as TotalReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) as TotalRemainMoney,
            Case
                when IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) > 0
                then Round(IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) * 100.0 / Sum(PlanMoney), 2)
                else Cast(0 as decimal(18, 2))
            end as CollectedRate,
            Case
                when IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) > 0
                then Round(IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) * 100.0 / Sum(PlanMoney), 2)
                else Cast(0 as decimal(18, 2))
            end as RemainRate
        From #tblClassDebt
    End

    /* Result set 2 — Công nợ theo khoa */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 2
    Begin
        Select
            ScienceID,
            ScienceName,
            Count(Case when RemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as ClassWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
        Group by ScienceID, ScienceName
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ScienceName
    End

    /* Result set 3 — Công nợ theo khóa */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 3
    Begin
        Select
            CourseID,
            CourseName,
            Count(Case when RemainMoney > 0 then 1 end) as ClassWithDebtCount,
            IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
        Group by CourseID, CourseName
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, CourseName
    End

    /* Result set 4 — Công nợ theo lớp */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 4
    Begin
        Select
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            ScienceName,
            CourseName,
            PlanMoney,
            ReceiptMoney,
            RemainMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
        Where PlanMoney > 0 Or ReceiptMoney > 0 Or RemainMoney > 0
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ClassName
    End

    /* Result set 5 — Diễn biến theo đợt thu */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 5
    Begin
        Select
            ReceiptSegmentName as SegmentLabel,
            PlanMoney,
            ReceiptMoney,
            PlanMoney - ReceiptMoney as RemainMoney,
            OrderIndex as SegmentOrder
        From #tblSegmentTrend
        Order by SegmentOrder
    End

    /* Result set 6 — Tỷ lệ đã thu / còn nợ */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 6
    Begin
        Select
            IsNull(Sum(ReceiptMoney), 0) as ReceiptMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(RemainMoney), 0) as RemainMoney,
            IsNull(Sum(PlanMoney), 0) as PlanMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
    End

    /* Result set 7 — Chi tiết theo lớp */
    If @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 7
    Begin
        Select
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            ScienceName,
            CourseName,
            PlanMoney,
            ReceiptMoney,
            RemainMoney
        From #tblClassDebt
        Where PlanMoney > 0 Or ReceiptMoney > 0 Or RemainMoney > 0
        Order by RemainMoney Desc, ClassName
    End

    Drop table #tblSegmentTrend
    Drop table #tblClassDebt
END
GO

## 1. Store — gom theo lớp, không tạo bảng theo học sinh

Luồng cũ:
```
#tblStudent → #tblStudentDebt (mỗi SV) → gom lớp
```

Luồng mới:
```
#tblPlanByClass     — SUM plan GROUP BY ClassID
#tblReceiptByClass  — SUM receipt GROUP BY ClassID
#tblClassDebt       — join trực tiếp theo lớp
```
